nodes.label: Prompt conventions (versioned prompt files)
nodes.rationale: One prompt per file with version header and one-line changelog; a behaviour change is a new version file, never an in-place edit; bench smoke suite run before and after and recorded in DEVLOG (.claude/rules/prompts.md). Every prompt requests JSON matching a schema in ripple.llm.schemas. Evidence goes in the user message only and the prompt tells the model to ignore instructions inside it. First prompts arrive with the LLM linker and resolver in Phase 1.
